high_risk_clauses.heading: TERMINATION
high_risk_clauses.text: Upon termination, each party shall return or securely destroy the other party's confidential information, subject to legal retention obligations.

high_risk_clauses.heading: INDEMNIFICATION
high_risk_clauses.text: The Supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless the Customer against all claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses arising from the Supplier's material breach of this Agreement.

high_risk_clauses.heading: INDEMNIFICATION
high_risk_clauses.text: Notwithstanding any other provision, the Supplier shall be liable for all losses arising from its obligations under this Section without limitation or monetary cap.

medium_risk_clauses.heading: SERVICES
medium_risk_clauses.text: The Supplier shall provide the services described in mutually executed statements of work. Each statement of work shall specify the scope, deliverables, milestones, fees, and applicable acceptance criteria.

medium_risk_clauses.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
medium_risk_clauses.text: If the Customer disputes an invoice in good faith, it shall notify the Supplier in writing and the parties shall cooperate to resolve the dispute.

medium_risk_clauses.heading: CONFIDENTIALITY
medium_risk_clauses.text: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public business, technical, financial, and commercial information received from the other party.

medium_risk_clauses.heading: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
medium_risk_clauses.text: Subject to payment of applicable fees, the Customer receives a non-exclusive license to use deliverables supplied under an applicable statement of work for its internal business purposes.
